newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Owners hopes of a revival fading.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Owners hopes of a revival fading.

text.p: Owner hopes of a revival to freight market rates continued to fade, with problems in shipping grain cargoes from the Mississippi and declining demand for panamaxes in the Pacific seen seen as negative, brokers said.
Widespread delays and strikes in loading areas are generating concern over market prospects in general, they added.
The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) shed another seven points to fix at 1,427, a loss of 40 points for the week and 86 points for the month so far.
GRAIN - Halla was said to have fixed the Baumare II on subjects for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Japan,
Shipment date was pegged for end April/early May at $24.25 no combo. This compares with Continental's fixture earlier in the week of Royal Ocean for April 15/25 at $24.00.
However, brokers were not optimistic that the subjects would be lifted for this forward position.

Earlier loading positions in the Mississippi were still problematical with persistent difficulties reported for April stems. As a result of this, some tonnage has ballasted away from U.S. Gulf to Brazil for business.
This has placed pressure on rates from south America, with vessels ballasting transatlantic heading in this direction.
Toepfer fixed the Navios-relet Chryssoula L for 50,000/5 tonnes heavy grain Nueva Palmira and Tubarao/Lisbon-Hamburg range for end April at $17.25 basis 2-1.
This compares with $18.00 reported earlier in the week and $18.35 a week ago, broekrs said.
NSAC was linked with Pan Ocean tonnage for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain up river Plate and Bahia Blanca/Japan for May 5/15 at $28.00 basis 2-1 (last fixed $29.50 by finagrain a week ago).
There was some confusion over Pan Ocean's fixing's of the Seatrans-relet Heraklia 65,159 dwt and the Torm Asia-relet Lamyra 64,879 dwt.
Reports from the U.S. suggested that these vessels were booked delivery U.S. Gulf end April/early May trip Japan at around $13,500 daily plus a $240,000 ballast bonus.
Some brokers though believed that at least one of them was fixed at this level delivery river Plate.

The situation was at least as difficult for owners from the north Pacific, where Continental re-introduced their enquiry for 54,000 tonnes heavy grain Nopac/Taiwan for April 29/May 9 but were said to have reduced their rate ideas to $14.00 from $14.50.
Few new enquiries were quoted, brokers said.

Amongst those that did emerge were Dreyfus with 23,750 up to 40,000 tonnes heavy grain and soyabean meal up river Plate to Spain for April 25/May 5 and 20,000 tonnes soyabean meal pellets Ilheus/Sete for spot shipment.
Cargill quoted 13,500/15,000 tonnes sunflower seeds from Montevideo/Guaymas for April 21/25.
MINERALS - Theogennitor 116,000 dwt was fixed delivery Jeddah end April trip via Goa with iron ore to China at $10,000 daily but failed on subjects.
Other which are said to have failed for similar business were Iolcos Flame 145,057 dwt and Caravos Star 113,828 dwt.
Alina 129,000 dwt failed on subjects with a timecharter fixture from west Australia to China.

Disturbing talk for owners circulated the market about the 1996-built panamax Oinoussian Lion, which was said to have failed on subjects overnight for an Australian round trip at $11,600 daily and now fixed on subjects for the same business to HMM at $11,000 daily.

The Belships-relet North Emperor 67,232 dwt which was said to have failed on subjects with Halla at close to $11,000 for a Nopac round trip, was linked with Noble for Roberts Bank/China coal, although some brokers discounted this talk.
Pan ocean was believed to have broken off negotiations with Flavia 65,282 dwt delivery Taiwan around April 20 for three to five months trading at $11,000 daily.
Bhp was reported to have fixed Elli 42,187 dwt delivery Hong Kong mid-April for a trip via New south Wales to USWC in the low $6,000's daily.
At 1515 GMT the BIFFEX futures stood five to 55 points down on Thursday's close. Most active April traded last at 1,410, down 55 points having traded 297 lots. Total volume ammounted to 549 lots.
